# Robotech CNC (روبوتك CNC)

> Robotech CNC is a trusted supplier of high-performance CNC routers, fiber lasers and woodworking machinery — known for precision, speed and reliability — helping Saudi factories grow with the latest manufacturing technology. Serving Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam and all of Saudi Arabia. 25+ years of experience, 2,415+ machines sold. Phone/WhatsApp: +966 50 845 0477.

## Machines (English)
- [Fiber Laser Cutting Machine for Metal Sheets](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/fiber-laser-cutting-machine/): High-speed, clean cutting of steel, stainless, aluminium and copper sheet.
- [Enclosed Fiber Laser Cutting Machine for Sheets & Tubes](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/enclosed-fiber-laser-cutting-machine/): Full enclosure, dual exchange table and rotary chuck for tubes — safer and more productive.
- [Handheld Fiber Laser Welding Machine](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/handheld-laser-welding-machine/): Faster, cleaner welds than TIG on stainless, steel and aluminium, with automatic wire feed.
- [Laser Cleaning Machine for Rust & Paint Removal](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/laser-cleaning-machine/): Removes rust, paint and oil without chemicals or sandblasting — and without damaging the surface.
- [Fiber Laser Marking Machine](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/fiber-laser-marking-machine/): Permanent marking of logos, serial numbers and QR codes on metals and plastics.
- [CO2 Laser Cutting & Engraving Machine 1325](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/co2-laser-cutting-engraving-1325/): Precise cutting and engraving of acrylic, wood, MDF and leather on a 1300×2500 mm bed.
- [CNC Router 1325 for Wood Cutting & Engraving](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/cnc-router-wood-1325/): Cuts, engraves and carves wood, MDF, acrylic and ACP with a powerful spindle and vacuum table.
- [Automatic Edge Banding Machine 4500AT](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/edge-banding-machine-4500at/): Fully automatic edge banding: pre-milling, gluing, end cutting, trimming, corner rounding and buffing.
- [Sliding Table Panel Saw 6132A](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/sliding-table-panel-saw-6132a/): Straight, precise cuts in MDF and melamine with a 3200 mm table and scoring blade.
- [Vacuum Membrane Laminating Press](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/vacuum-laminating-machine/): Wraps kitchen and interior doors in PVC film or veneer for a bubble-free finish.
- [Single-Head Door Lock Mortising Machine](https://robotechcnc.com/en/products/door-lock-mortising-machine/): Precise lock-case mortising and handle boring in wooden doors with pneumatic clamping.
